module.purpose: Provides IndexedDB-backed persistence for tldraw document records, schemas, session snapshots, and assets, including migration from the legacy asset database.
module.summary: This module wraps IndexedDB access behind a persistence class with transaction tracking, close coordination, document snapshot and incremental-change storage, session retention, and asset operations. It maintains a local database-name index for legacy migration discovery, initializes required object stores, migrates old assets into the current database, and protects transaction completion behavior during closure and React strict-mode lifecycle patterns.
module.businessContext: Supports offline and durable browser editing for tldraw documents and assets. Failure can lose local document state, session restoration data, or embedded assets.

units.name: tx

detail.name: tx
detail.signature: private tx<Names extends StoreName[], Mode extends IDBTransactionMode, T>(mode: Mode, names: Names, cb: (tx: IDBPTransaction<StoreName, Names, Mode>) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
preconditions: The LocalIndexedDb instance must not be closed when the transaction operation begins.
mode must be a valid IndexedDB transaction mode.
names must identify valid stores for the database.
cb must be an asynchronous callback accepting the created transaction.
postconditions: On normal completion while the database remains open, the callback result is returned only after the IndexedDB transaction completes.
If the instance is closed before final transaction completion, the transaction is aborted rather than awaited to completion.
A transaction completion failure is propagated when the instance is not closed.
invariants: The callback receives the transaction created for the supplied store names and mode.
The transaction completion promise is observed immediately to prevent an unhandled rejection.
Transaction completion is awaited in the normal open-instance path regardless of whether the callback resolves or rejects.
edgeCases: If the instance is already closed, the operation fails before opening the database or creating a transaction.
If the callback rejects, its rejection is propagated unless transaction-finalization awaiting produces a different failure.
If the instance closes while the callback or transaction is active, transaction completion errors are suppressed and the transaction is aborted during cleanup.

raises: Assertion error when the database is closed
IndexedDB transaction or database errors while the instance remains open
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Rejects when the instance is closed or when database transaction creation, callback execution, or transaction completion fails.

detail.summary: Executes an asynchronous callback within an IndexedDB transaction over the requested stores and returns the callback result. It rejects use after closure and coordinates transaction completion or abortion with the database lifecycle.

units.name: load

detail.name: load
preconditions: The LocalIndexedDb instance must be usable for opening a readonly transaction over the records, schema, and session-state stores.
postconditions: Returns an object containing the persisted records, the schema row keyed by Table.Schema, and a sessionStateSnapshot.

The returned sessionStateSnapshot is the requested session snapshot when a sessionId is supplied and its snapshot is truthy; otherwise it is the snapshot from the session-state row with the greatest updatedAt value, or undefined when no snapshot is available.
invariants: The operation uses a readonly transaction.
The records, schema, and session-state stores are read within the same transaction.
edgeCases: With no sessionId, all session-state rows are examined and the snapshot with the greatest updatedAt value is selected.
With a sessionId whose row is absent or whose snapshot is falsy, the method falls back to the most recently updated session-state row.
With no session-state rows or no available snapshots, sessionStateSnapshot is undefined.
Records and schema are returned even when no session-state snapshot is available.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Resolves to an object of the form { records: await recordsStore.getAll(), schema: await schemaStore.get(Table.Schema), sessionStateSnapshot: SessionStateSnapshotRow['snapshot'] | undefined | null }. The records value is the complete records-store contents; schema is the row stored under Table.Schema.
detail.summary: Loads all persisted records and schema data, together with the most appropriate session-state snapshot. A requested session snapshot is preferred when present; otherwise the most recently updated session snapshot is returned.

specTests.then: The result contains all records, the schema row under Table.Schema, and the snapshot from the session-state row with the greatest updatedAt value.
The result uses the requested session's snapshot rather than the newer snapshot.
The result falls back to the snapshot from the most recently updated session-state row.

detail.name: pruneSessions
preconditions: The LocalIndexedDb instance can open a read-write transaction for the SessionState table.
postconditions: If fewer than ten session-state records exist, no records are deleted.

The returned promise resolves after the transaction completes successfully.
